newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Danish May consumer confidence seen down.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Danish May consumer confidence seen down.

text.p: A Reuter consensus of eight economists' forecasts on Friday showed May consumer confidence falling slightly from its high April rating of +11.
The average forecast was for a May rating of +10, from estimates ranging from a low of eight to a high of 11.
The weighted rating, next due on May 20, has only ever reached the +11 level six times in its 17-year history and has never gone higher.

The survey asks a cross section of Denmark's population its views on current personal and national economic trends, along with consumer intentions for coming months. Changes in consumer confidence are indicated by a higher or lower weighted rating, rather than by index.
